statuses.proxy: Computed from a documented proxy for a stat the free NHL API does not expose.
statuses.none: Not exposed by the free NHL API; scored as a neutral 50.

sections.label: Front Office
sections.description: Roster construction and front-office context signals.

sections.label: Coaching
sections.description: Preparation, line continuity, and in-game response signals.

sections.label: Opponents
sections.description: Schedule-strength context derived from opponents' current power.

sections.label: Global
sections.description: Outcome, comeback, and special-team impact signals.

metrics.label: Cap Space
metrics.description: Cap space is not available from the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.

metrics.label: Depth
metrics.description: Counts skaters with at least 20 points in the current target-season skater report.

metrics.label: Lineup Stability
metrics.description: Measures how uneven regular-skater participation is; less dispersion around the mean is better.

metrics.label: Team Experience in Playoffs
metrics.description: Uses average derived NHL seasons of experience among regular skaters as a proxy for playoff experience.

metrics.label: Player Average Age
metrics.description: Uses the current calendar age of regular skaters and applies a bell-shaped score centered at the production ideal.

metrics.label: Team Average Height
metrics.description: Averages the reported heights of regular skaters; taller is higher under the production direction.

metrics.label: Team Average Weight
metrics.description: Averages the reported weights of regular skaters; heavier is higher under the production direction.

metrics.label: Line Stability
metrics.description: Uses average games played by the top six forwards and top four defensemen as a proxy for stable core lines and pairs.

metrics.label: Won Coach Challenges
metrics.description: Won coach challenges are not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.

metrics.label: Empty-Net Goals per Game (Proxy)
metrics.description: Uses empty-net goals per team game as the production proxy for empty-net success.

metrics.label: Goals within 5 min after Coach Timeout
metrics.description: Counts goals scored within five minutes after one of the team's own coach timeouts.

metrics.label: First 10 Minutes Goals For/Against
metrics.description: Measures the share of first-ten-minute regulation goals scored for the team.

metrics.label: 3+ Goal Routes (Blowout Losses)
metrics.description: Counts losses that were routes by at least three goals after removing the opponent's empty-net goals.

metrics.label: Top 5 Players Production Ratio
metrics.description: Measures the share of team skater points produced by the five highest-point skaters.

metrics.label: Average Points Top 9 Forwards
metrics.description: Averages points among the nine highest-point forwards, with a single-game availability override when supplied.

metrics.label: Average Points Top 4 Defensemen
metrics.description: Averages points among the four highest-point defensemen, with a single-game availability override when supplied.

metrics.label: Bottom-6 Forwards Points/Game
metrics.description: Averages points per game among the forwards ranked 7-12 by ice time per game (the third and fourth lines), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
metrics.unit: points per game per bottom-six forward

metrics.label: Bottom-Pair Defensemen Points/Game
metrics.description: Averages points per game among the defensemen ranked 5-6 by ice time per game (the third pair), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
metrics.unit: points per game per bottom-pair defenseman

metrics.label: Shots / Game
metrics.description: Uses official team shots on goal per game, with a play-by-play fallback for a new or incomplete season.

metrics.label: Scoring Chances / Game
metrics.description: Counts all parsed play-by-play shot attempts—goals, shots on goal, missed shots, and blocked shots—whose production danger value is at least 0.1 and divides by games played.

metrics.label: Shot Attempts / Game
metrics.description: Uses total shot attempts from the official realtime report, with a play-by-play fallback when the summary is unavailable.

metrics.label: Shot Quality (avg danger/attempt)
metrics.description: Averages the production play-by-play danger value assigned to the team's shot attempts.

metrics.label: Plus/Minus Overall
metrics.description: Sums the plus/minus values of the team's skaters.

metrics.label: Shot-Attempt Share (Off Zone Proxy)
metrics.description: Uses shot-attempt share as the production proxy for time in the offensive zone.

metrics.label: Time with the Lead
metrics.description: Averages regulation time spent holding a lead across the team's games.

metrics.label: Comebacks from 2+ Goal Deficit
metrics.description: Counts wins after the team trailed by at least two goals.

metrics.label: Comebacks in 3rd Periods
metrics.description: Counts wins after the team trailed during the third period.

metrics.label: Goals / Powerplay Minute
metrics.description: Measures powerplay goals per powerplay minute.

metrics.label: Points / Powerplay Minute
metrics.description: Measures powerplay points (goals plus assists) per powerplay minute. This is the creation half of the powerplay: goals alone score finishing, and the unit's best passer generates them without scoring them.

metrics.label: Top 5 Production Ratio vs Team (PP)
metrics.description: Measures the share of team powerplay points produced by the five highest-point powerplay skaters; concentration is lower-is-better.

metrics.label: Top 2 Defensemen Production vs Team (PP)
metrics.description: Measures the share of team powerplay points produced by the two highest-point defensemen; concentration is lower-is-better.

metrics.label: Shorthanded Goals Allowed
metrics.description: Measures shorthanded goals allowed—goals against while the opponent is shorthanded—per game; fewer is better.

metrics.label: Opponent Shots / Game
metrics.description: Measures shots on goal allowed per game, with a play-by-play fallback.
metrics.unit: shots on goal against per game

metrics.label: Goals Against / Game
metrics.description: Measures goals allowed per game, with a play-by-play fallback.

metrics.label: Opp Average Points Top 9 Forwards
metrics.description: Computes the opponent-weighted average points per opponent top-nine forward using actual games played against each opponent when available.

metrics.label: Opp Average Points Top 4 Defensemen
metrics.description: Computes the opponent-weighted average points per opponent top-four defenseman using actual games played against each opponent when available.

metrics.label: Opp Scoring Chances / Game
metrics.description: Measures opponent scoring chances allowed per game.

metrics.label: Opp Shot Attempts / Game
metrics.description: Measures opponent shot attempts allowed per game, with a play-by-play fallback.

metrics.label: Opponent Shot Quality (allowed)
metrics.description: Averages the production danger value of shot attempts allowed.
metrics.unit: danger value per allowed shot attempt

metrics.label: Team Plus/Minus (Opponent Context; Audit)
metrics.description: Uses the negative of the team's skater plus/minus as raw input and then applies lower-is-better normalization.

metrics.label: Opponent Shot-Attempt Share (Zone Proxy)
metrics.description: Uses opponent shot-attempt share as the production proxy for opponent offensive-zone time.

metrics.label: Opp Time with the Lead
metrics.description: Averages regulation time the opponent spent holding a lead, which is the team's trailing time.

metrics.label: Opp Comebacks from 2+ Goal Deficit
metrics.description: Counts opponent wins after the opponent trailed by at least two goals against this team.

metrics.label: Opp Comebacks in 3rd Periods
metrics.description: Counts opponent wins after the opponent trailed during the third period against this team.

metrics.label: Auxiliary Goalie Goal Against Ratio
metrics.description: Uses the announced non-main goalie's GAA when available; otherwise weights backup goalies' GAA by games played.

metrics.label: Primary Goalie Game Ratio
metrics.description: Measures the starting goalie's share of team games started, with an announced alternate override.

metrics.label: Team Plus/Minus (Defense Context; Duplicate)
metrics.description: Sums the team's skater plus/minus values in the defense section; higher is the production direction.

metrics.label: Bottom-6 Forwards Plus/Minus per Game
metrics.description: Averages plus/minus per game among the forwards ranked 7-12 by ice time per game (the third and fourth lines), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
metrics.unit: plus/minus per game per bottom-six forward

metrics.label: Bottom-Pair Defensemen Plus/Minus per Game
metrics.description: Averages plus/minus per game among the defensemen ranked 5-6 by ice time per game (the third pair), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
metrics.unit: plus/minus per game per bottom-pair defenseman

metrics.label: Blocked Shots / Game
metrics.description: Measures total blocked shots per game from the realtime team report.

metrics.label: Shut Outs
metrics.description: Uses the team's total shutouts from the season summary.

metrics.label: Goals Allowed / PK Minute
metrics.description: Measures goals allowed per penalty-kill minute.

metrics.label: Shorthanded Opportunities / PK Minute (Proxy)
metrics.description: Uses shorthanded opportunities per penalty-kill minute as the production proxy for shots allowed per penalty-kill minute.

metrics.label: Penalty-Kill TOI per Game (Def Zone Proxy)
metrics.description: Uses penalty-kill ice time per game as the production proxy for time in the defensive zone on the penalty kill.

metrics.label: Blocked Shots / Game (PK)
metrics.description: Scales total blocked shots per game by the team's penalty-kill share of its three major special-team/5-on-5 time components.
metrics.unit: blocked shots per game scaled to PK workload

metrics.label: Shorthanded Goals Scored
metrics.description: Uses total shorthanded goals scored across the target season.

metrics.label: OT Win Ratio (wins / opportunities)
metrics.description: Measures OT-only wins over a denominator that still includes standing overtime losses, which may include shootout losses.

metrics.label: Goals by Top 3 Players / Whole Team (OT)
metrics.description: Measures the share of team overtime goals scored by its top three overtime scorers.

metrics.label: Number of Different Goal Scorers (OT)
metrics.description: Counts distinct players with a recorded overtime goal.

metrics.label: Shots / OT
metrics.description: Measures OT shot-on-goal events for per overtime game; goals are excluded by the current parser.
metrics.unit: OT shot-on-goal events per overtime game, excluding goals

metrics.label: Shots Against / OT
metrics.description: Measures OT shot-on-goal events against per overtime game; goals are excluded by the current parser.
metrics.unit: OT shot-on-goal events against per overtime game, excluding goals

metrics.label: Time in Offensive Zone / OT Game
metrics.description: Time in the offensive zone per overtime game is not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.

metrics.label: Time in Defensive Zone / OT Game
metrics.description: Time in the defensive zone per overtime game is not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.

metrics.label: Individual Talent Quality (OT)
metrics.description: Uses the sum of the best forward's and best defenseman's points per game as a proxy for individual overtime talent.
metrics.unit: points per game, summed across two players

metrics.label: SO Win Ratio (wins / opportunities)
metrics.description: Measures the share of shootout opportunities won.

metrics.label: Number of Different Scorers
metrics.description: Counts skaters with at least one shootout goal.

metrics.label: Individual Talent Quality (SO)
metrics.description: Uses team shootout shooting percentage among skaters with shootout attempts.

metrics.label: Team Shootout Save Percentage
metrics.description: Uses the team's official shootout save percentage.

metrics.label: Opponent Strength (Avg Opponent Power)
metrics.description: Derives opponent strength from the current power scores of teams played, then exposes both a standardized opponent section score and the bounded factor used by the final score.

metrics.label: OT Wins Ratio
metrics.description: Uses the same OT-only numerator and standing overtime-loss denominator as the overtime section.

metrics.label: Regulation Win Ratio
metrics.description: Measures the share of games won in regulation.

metrics.label: SO Win Ratio
metrics.description: Uses the share of shootout opportunities won from the season standing.

metrics.label: Comeback Wins
metrics.description: Counts wins after the team trailed at any point in a game.

metrics.label: 2-Goal Comeback Wins
metrics.description: Counts wins after the team trailed by at least two goals.

metrics.label: Last 5-Minute Comeback Wins
metrics.description: Counts wins where the team was trailing at the five-minute checkpoint in the third period, inferred from the last scoring event at or before 5:00.

metrics.label: Powerplay Impacts
metrics.description: Uses the share of non-shorthanded goals scored on the powerplay; teams relying less on the powerplay rank higher.

metrics.label: Penalty Kill Impacts
metrics.description: Uses the share of goals against remaining after shorthanded and powerplay goals are removed; the residual can include empty-net goals.
metrics.unit: non-powerplay, non-shorthanded residual share of goals against

metrics.label: Losses Despite High Scoring Chances
metrics.description: Counts losses where the team's play-by-play expected-goal proxy exceeded the opponent's actual goals.

note: Public definitions only. Scoring formulas, normalization, aggregation, weights, data sources, and update internals are not published.
